static_traits.name: 林晓彤
static_traits.occupation: Hospital staff member；社区学院在读Student
static_traits.social_status: 近期与同事保持距离，担心被看出困难；有一位要好的朋友但not yet分享自卑与Anxiety
static_traits.medical_history: without既往类似心理问题与咨询经历；without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能具体描述事件与情绪；自我批评明显，常用“应该”句式；Anxiety与内疚体验强；对重构持保留但配合度较高

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得因为我同时在上学，所以我应该成为更好的Hospital staff member。这一信念导致了Guilt, stress和自我not足感。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because persistent guilt and stress are affecting my mental health and overall well-being.
growth_experiences: About 6 months ago I began simultaneously handling hospital work and community college study; in examination weeks or busy work periods stress and guilt intensify, especially after receiving work feedback or school grades it recurs weekly. To cope, I doubled my effort in work and study and consulted colleagues, but the negative emotions persist.
一次倒车时not慎撞到树，事后反复回放事故，形成“我是最差的司机/我会再次出错”的想法，出现驾车Anxiety并开始Avoids driving，导致跑腿与社交活动受影响。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/能力not足
My worth depends on outstanding performance at work and in studies

special_situations.event: 在工作中收到上级或同事的反馈
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not比以前做得更好或not够完美，就证明I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加班加点、更用力工作、向同事请教，同时与同事保持距离以避免暴露not足
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我应该做得更好，我在让大家失望

special_situations.event: 在学校Receiving grades或临近期末考试
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果成绩not优秀，就说明I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Investing more time in studying, using 'must/should' self-demands
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我必须考得更好，否则就证明我not行

special_situations.event: 在事故后需要开车或想到要开车
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 犯过一次错就意味着我not安全、今后也会继续出错
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 尽量避免驾驶，仅在not得已时短途行驶
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我又会出错/可能再出事故

special_situations.event: 回想起倒车撞树的那次事故
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次错误就足以证明我整体很差
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly replays in his mind and criticizes himself, hoping to 'learn a lesson' and avoid repeating mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am the worst driver in the world

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen as competent and reliable, and to be recognized and connected at work and in studies
core_conflict.fear: 害怕暴露without能被批评、被看not起，引发羞耻与被排斥
defense_goal: 通过自我苛责与追求完美来控制not确定性与Anxiety
与同事保持距离以避免暴露not足、降低羞耻感

object_relations.self_representation: not够好、容易出错、带着羞耻的员工/Student
object_relations.object_representation: Others are harsh judges, people who will pick faults at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师提出将“我是最差司机”重构为“我犯了一个错误，但这not代表我是坏司机”并邀请练习时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes this is like self-deception or being asked to ignore the seriousness of mistakes
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以平静理性的语气强调“这听起来not真实”，坚持证据标准，减少情感表达。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests sharing feelings with family and friends and seeking support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 预设他人not会理解，会认为自己反应过度
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 用not确定但negate性的表述，如“他们会觉得我反应过度吧”，并Displacement话题，避免深入探索。

manifestations: 与同事保持距离，担心被看出挣扎
not向亲密朋友分享自卑与Anxiety，担心not被理解
outcomes: Increased subjective sense of isolation，支持系统利用not足

manifestations: Bound by internalized 'should/must' rules in self-worth
Binds self-worth to perfect performance; hard to choose flexibly
outcomes: 在驾驶和社交上出现回避，Restricted life choices

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 频繁use“我应该/必须……”来要求自己
Regarding high standards in work and study as the sole basis of self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'
manifestations: 预设朋友会觉得自己“反应过度”而not愿求助
担心同事会注意到自己的挣扎并negate自己

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 反复自责“我是最差的司机”
对积极重构反馈为“not真实”，对自我表达较为谨慎

positive_force: 能主动寻求建议（曾向同事请教）
具备自我观察与Reflection的基础，愿意尝试新思路
拥有一位可潜在求助的亲密朋友
除这次事故外without其他重大交通事故，客观能力并非全然not足
negative_force: Excessively high self-demands, conditions of worth based on perfection
过度概括与预测not yet来的思维维持Anxiety（尤其在驾驶情境）
回避行为（Avoids driving、疏离同事）Reinforcement了恐惧与羞耻
Sleep and diet rhythm disturbance，削弱情绪调节能力

target_behavior.behavior: 与驾驶相关的强烈Anxiety与回避
antecedent: 想到要开车或坐上驾驶座
需要外出跑腿或Attending social activities
target_behavior.core_reason: After a single accident of reversing into a tree, developed overgeneralization and the catastrophizing/predictive cognition 'I will make mistakes again'
target_behavior.function: 逃避被感知为危险的情境，以暂时降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 日常办事与社交活动受限，维持并加剧驾驶Anxiety与Self-denial

antecedent: 在工作场合与同事接触
收到工作反馈后担心暴露not足
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕被看作without能、被评价与羞耻
target_behavior.function: Avoids being evaluated and seen in one's 'weaknesses' to maintain a surface sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Support system reduced, interpersonal trust declined, guilt and stress maintained

target_behavior.core_reason: 将外界高标准内化为自我价值的唯一依据（Introjection），以完美主义维持控制感
target_behavior.function: Tries to improve performance through self-pressure and avoid being blamed
target_behavior.consequence: 内疚与Rising stress，Sleep and diet disturbance，Decline in work performance
